components.text: The Speed Rune increases all of the crafting operations of the Blood Altar. The crafting speed (and speed that the progress is lost when empty) increases by an additive +20% per rune.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Speed Rune to its augmented form, increasing the crafting rate by an additive +40% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
